title: situation.indian_territory_posts_given_up.title
railroad: the Army gives up its posts in the Indian Territory between mid-April and early May (Fort Washita about 15 to 16 April, Fort Smith 23 April, Fort Arbuckle 3 May, Fort Cobb before 9 May); orders to them are not modelled, so they go on their dates once the call is made

citations.at: I-1 pp. 648 to 650 (the posts given up)
